_note: Universe Reel — Sophie's shot list, verbatim. `image` and `motion` are her own words from docs/universe-reel-shotlist.md and are sent to the models UNCHANGED; nothing here is a paraphrase or a rewrite. `order` is the final edit order from Part 2 of her doc. `plan` is the only added field — how each shot should be produced, and why.

shots.title: Clay Creation
shots.image: Giant weathered hands molding a glowing blue-green clay sphere, visible thumbprints pressed into continents, dark cosmic void background, soft divine light from above, cinematic, hyper-detailed clay texture
shots.motion: Open mid-action: hands already pressing and rotating the sphere, thumbprints forming mountain ranges, clay smoothing into oceans, camera slowly orbiting the hands

shots.title: Souls Descending
shots.image: Translucent glowing light-beings drifting down from a bright sky toward empty human bodies standing in a misty field, ethereal, volumetric light rays, serene
shots.motion: Orbs of light fall gently from the sky, each merges into a standing body; on contact the body's eyes open and it takes a first breath, color returning to the skin
shots.plan: MATCH-CUT PAIR with shot03. Render its last frame with return_last_frame, or animate on wan-2.7 with last_frame set, so the descent lands on a known pose that shot03 can copy.

shots.title: Match Cut: Game Drop
shots.image: Third-person video game screenshot style: stylized character skydiving toward a vibrant island landscape below, subtle HUD elements at screen edges, game-engine lighting, crisp stylized rendering
shots.motion: Character falls from the sky in identical framing and motion to the souls shot, lands in a crouch, stands, starts running; a minimal health bar fades in at the corner
shots.plan: THE CORE MOMENT (her note: framing must match shot02 exactly). wan-2.7 with `image` = a game-style still built to shot02's framing. This is the one shot worth paying per-second for.

shots.title: Waking Up (First-Person POV)
shots.image: First-person POV of eyes opening for the first time: blurry warm light, soft out-of-focus faces or sky above, lens-like vignette of eyelids at frame edges, dreamlike
shots.motion: Black screen; eyelids open slowly, world comes into focus from blur — light, color, a sky or a face above; a faint soft UI flicker at the very edge of vision, almost subliminal
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro, 12s 1080p. The opening black and the focus pull may be cleaner done in the edit than asked of the model.

shots.title: Forgetting (The Veil)
shots.image: Close-up of a person whose chest and eyes hold a soft inner glow, the glow visibly dimming, expression shifting from serene knowing to ordinary blankness, muted colors creeping in
shots.motion: The inner glow in the person's chest and eyes gently fades to nothing; their gaze changes from wonder to everyday distraction; the world around them desaturates slightly
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro, 12s 1080p. Pairs with shot11 — the glow returning there should read as this reversed, so keep the same face if a re-roll is needed.

shots.title: Other Players
shots.image: Busy city crosswalk viewed from above, every person carrying a faint identical glow of light inside their chest, subtle, no one noticing, cinematic wide shot
shots.motion: Crowd walks normally; slowly the camera reveals a soft light pulsing inside every single person in sync, then the glow fades back to invisibility as the shot ends
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro, 12s 1080p. The synced pulse is the risky part — may need 2-3 re-rolls, which flat pricing makes cheap.

shots.title: Tiny Sphere Walk
shots.image: Tiny stylized planet in the style of Super Mario Galaxy, lone character standing on top, entire sphere visible in frame with miniature trees and hills, curved horizon, space backdrop, charming and clean
shots.motion: Character walks and circles the entire tiny planet in exactly ten steps, camera fixed in space, ending back where they started, casual and loopable
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro with camera_fixed (--lock) — her motion note asks for a fixed camera explicitly. 'Exactly ten steps' and 'ending where they started' is a loop; expect several tries.

shots.title: Day/Night Rotation
shots.image: Earth-like sphere half in golden sunlight, half in star-speckled night, terminator line crisp, viewed from space, painterly
shots.imageB: Game engine editor view of the same sphere with a visible "time of day" slider UI at the bottom of the screen
shots.motion: The sphere rotates and sunlight sweeps across its surface; cut to the game-editor version where a slider drags and the same light sweep happens instantly
shots.plan: TWO images (her A and B), TWO clips, cut together in the edit — one model call can't do the cut.

shots.title: Render-on-Look
shots.image: Landscape half-loaded like a video game: foreground fully detailed forest, background dissolving into wireframe and blank untextured chunks, split-reality feel
shots.motion: As a character turns their head, terrain chunks pop in — wireframe, then flat color, then full texture — always resolving just ahead of their gaze
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro, 12s 1080p. Chunk pop-in is a hard ask; the wireframe→texture stages may be better as an edit-side overlay on a simpler clip.

shots.title: Light-Speed Cap
shots.image: A runner sprinting through a dark cosmic void toward a glowing translucent wall of light stretching infinitely in every direction, speed lines, the barrier faintly shimmering
shots.motion: Runner accelerates, motion blur intensifies, then hits an invisible barrier that ripples like glass; they cannot pass; the wall shimmers and settles

shots.title: Ascension: Leaving the Body
shots.image: An elderly person lying peacefully in a sunlit field, a translucent glowing light-being rising out of the body, a tether of light dissolving, ethereal, volumetric rays
shots.motion: The light-being lifts gently out of the body, hovers a moment looking down, then begins rising — the descent from Shot 2, reversed; its inner glow visibly returns as it rises
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro, 12s 1080p. Her note says this is shot02 reversed — worth trying an ffmpeg reverse of shot02's clip as a free alternate take to cut against.

shots.title: Rising Through the Clouds
shots.image: Glowing orb of light ascending through towering golden-white clouds, god rays, vast heavenly scale, soft warm palette
shots.motion: Continuous upward camera move following the light-being through cloud layers, each layer brighter than the last, streaks of light rushing past
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro, 12s 1080p. A continuous camera move is what these models do best — expect this one to land first try.

shots.title: Level Up (Ending)
shots.image: Above the clouds: radiant open space, the light-being glowing brighter and larger than before, a subtle golden ring or gate ahead in the distance
shots.motion: The being breaks through the final cloud layer; minimal glowing text floats upward — "LEVEL 2" — then fades as the being drifts toward the light; cut to black
shots.plan: seedance-1.5-pro for the motion, but the "LEVEL 2" text is added in the EDIT — video models render text unreliably, and this is the last frame of the film.

shots.title: Transition Motif — Loading Shimmer
shots.image: Abstract soft shimmer of light particles and faint wireframe grid, translucent, gentle blue-gold gradient, minimal, ethereal
shots.motion: A soft wave of shimmering light particles sweeps across the frame left to right, briefly revealing a faint wireframe grid beneath the image before dissolving, 0.5 second wipe
shots.plan: NOT A MODEL CALL. A 0.5s wipe used between beats is an ffmpeg/edit-side overlay generated once and reused — free, consistent every time, and a model would draw it differently on each of the 12 uses.

shots.title: Clay Creation — thumbprint macro (optional extra)
shots.image: Extreme close-up of a single thumbprint becoming a mountain range, macro detail
shots.motion: The thumbprint ridges slowly rise into mountain ranges, macro detail holding still around them
shots.plan: Her marked optional extra. Cheap insert cutaway for shot01.
